description: Fiberweb (India) Limited manufactures and sells spunbond and melt-blown nonwoven fabrics from polypropylene in India. Its products are used in hygiene, agricultural, medical and industrial garments, automotive, geotextiles/structural engineering, textile, oil absorbents, electronics, filtration, sanitary products, and apparel applications. The company exports its products to the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, and the Gulf countries. The company was formerly known as PVD Plast Mould Industries Limited. Fiberweb (India) Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
